description: Use an existing paid watch pass to follow package, publisher, repository and domain changes. Never purchases a pass. The listing must already be in your watchlist. No separate purchase. Sources refresh every six hours through shared caches. Source quotas can defer a check. History records before, after, source and observation date. Domain expiry alerts use 30, 15 and 7 days when the registry publishes a date. Missing dates and source failures remain unverified. Account holders receive operational e-mail; wallet owners read API history. No account-recovery or takeover attempt is made.
name: watch_dependency_changes
title: Watch dependency changes
